dct_description_sm: OLab and OpenLabyrinth have been openly available since 2004.

OLab4 is an education research platform. This is an overview of its capabilities and how to use it. Main site: https//olab4.net but example cases can be found at https://player.olab4.net -- the main example maps, such as this one do not require a login to play. Some other map examples are specific to our book: you can find login details in Chapter 1 of the book.
